## Summary

The specification required the owner duplicate checks to ignore letter case and surrounding/repeated whitespace, so `"  john   smith "` and `"John Smith"` are treated as the same value.

Changes made:

1. **`DuplicateKey.java`** (new) — a small package-private helper with `normalize(String)` that strips leading/trailing whitespace, collapses internal whitespace runs to a single space, and lower-cases (Locale.ROOT). Returns `null` for `null` so "no value" stays distinct.

2. **`CheckDuplicateOwner.java`** — telephone comparison now compares normalized values on both sides.

3. **`CheckDuplicateOwnerEmail.java`** — email comparison now compares normalized values on both sides (still short-circuiting when the email is absent/blank, since email is optional).

Both duplicate detectors now compare via `DuplicateKey.normalize(...)`, so case and whitespace variations of the same value collide as duplicates and map to 409 Conflict as before.
